_comment: ComfyUI environment inventory configuration — the ONLY approved roots the strong-inventory machinery may resolve model files or core identity from. Hashing always runs locally on the host that stores the files (PRESTO via read-only ssh+powershell, vidnux via local streaming). Registry-required filenames are the only allowed targets; arbitrary paths are rejected at generation time. Live manifests land in gitignored state/comfyui-environments/<host>/.
